subject: English
question_text: Use capitals and punctuation marks where necessary in the following text.
stimulus: do not worry about a few mistakes said the teacher you can learn a lot through your mistakes do we learn from our mistakes asked the boy yes we learn. Part−B : Composition [40 Marks]
guide_solution: Capitalization and punctuation “Do not worry about a few mistakes,” said the teacher. “You can learn a lot through your mistakes.” “Do we learn from our mistakes?” asked the boy. “Yes, we learn.” Part−B : Composition See SSC English Made Easy To Test Papers Book 210
